aiReview.summary: Official API documentation covering OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible endpoints, first-call setup, models, and agent-tool integrations. Strong fit for a DeepSeek developer directory as maintained first-party docs.
evidence: canonicalUrl https://api-docs.deepseek.com with title Your First API Call | DeepSeek API Docs
Meta description states OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible API format and SDK reuse
Page lists base_url https://api.deepseek.com, Anthropic path, models deepseek-flash and deepseek-v4-pro
Includes curl to /chat/completions and links to agent integrations and Anthropic API guide
uncertainty: Full doc tree completeness and Chinese locale quality not fully reviewed
Current pricing tiers and rate limits live on platform.deepseek.com, not fully verified here
aiReview.tagline: Official OpenAI-compatible API docs and first-call guide
aiReview.description: Configure OpenAI or Anthropic SDKs against the hosted API, with model names, chat examples, and agent-tool integration notes.
pros: Hosted at api-docs.deepseek.com as first-party Docusaurus documentation.
Documents OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible base URLs, API keys, and current model names.
Includes a concrete chat/completions curl example plus links to agent integrations.
Notes legacy model aliases and billing behavior for retired Flash names.
cons: Homepage is a quick-start page rather than a full API reference index.
API usage itself is billed via platform keys; docs do not replace pricing or SLA pages.

aiReview.summary: Official developer console for obtaining API keys and using the hosted chat API, which is OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible.

aiReview.description: Sign in to manage API keys and call hosted chat models via OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible endpoints.

API docs describe OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible base URLs and chat completions.
Documented models include deepseek-flash and deepseek-v4-pro.

aiReview.summary: Third-party ResearchGate comparison paper covering Grok, Gemini, ChatGPT, and DeepSeek; not official docs, a model card, or developer tooling, so it is a weak fit for a DeepSeek developer directory.
evidence: canonicalUrl is a ResearchGate publication titled Grok Gemini ChatGPT and DeepSeek Comparison and Applications in Conversational Artificial Intelligence.
Discovered from milisp/awesome-grok README with generic ResearchGate anchor text.
Rubric prefers official docs, model cards, and SDKs over news-style or informal comparison pieces.
uncertainty: Full paper text, peer-review status, authors, and venue could not be fetched (HTTP 403).
Whether the PDF is openly downloadable without a ResearchGate account is unverified.
aiReview.tagline: Academic comparison of several conversational AI systems
aiReview.description: Surveys Grok, Gemini, ChatGPT, and DeepSeek and discusses conversational AI applications in a ResearchGate publication.
pros: Title indicates a multi-model comparison that includes DeepSeek among other conversational systems.
Hosted as a ResearchGate publication rather than an anonymous blog post.
cons: Not official DeepSeek documentation, a Hugging Face model card, or a maintained SDK.

Title-only listing in awesome-grok does not demonstrate methodology quality or recency of model versions.
